dialogues.jp:
俺や音夢、杉並を含めた６人の班で、百人一首
カルタを囲む。
dialogues.en:
Nemu, Suginami and I, as well as 6 other people, surrounded
the Hyakunin Isshu* playing cards.
dialogues.text:
Nemu, Suginami and I, as well as 6 other people, surrounded
the Hyakunin Isshu* playing cards.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうやらお前と決着をつけるときがきたよう
　だな」
dialogues.en: "Looks like the time has come for us to settle this."
dialogues.text: "Looks like the time has come for us to settle this."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「１番になったやつがジュースを｛おご／奢｝るってのは
　どうだ」
dialogues.en:
"The one who gets first place shall be treated by everyone
else to a packet of juice."
dialogues.text:
"The one who gets first place shall be treated by everyone
else to a packet of juice."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "First place... then what about last place?"
dialogues.text: "First place... then what about last place?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並が無言でうなずく。

こいつの脳内では、きっと、その反対の“１番”
が誰になるかは決まっているんだろう。
dialogues.en:
That bastard... he's already decided in his head who would
be first and who would be last.
dialogues.text:
That bastard... he's already decided in his head who would
be first and who would be last.

dialogues.jp: まあ、エライ自信じゃないか。
ふたりの間で火花が散る。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、ふたりとも。始まりますよ」
dialogues.en: "Look alive you two, we're going to start."
dialogues.text: "Look alive you two, we're going to start."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が教壇に上がり、読み札を手にする。
dialogues.en:
Mako was standing at the front of the class, holding a piece
of paper.
dialogues.text:
Mako was standing at the front of the class, holding a piece
of paper.

dialogues.jp: （この班の勝利候補は音夢だろうな）
dialogues.en: "(Nemu'd be our best shot at winning this...)"
dialogues.text: "(Nemu'd be our best shot at winning this...)"

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも１番になれなければ、賭けは無効。
そう頑張ることもあるまい。
dialogues.en:
The two of them are proven masters at this, no one would bet
otherwise. There's almost no point in anyone else even
trying.
dialogues.text:
The two of them are proven masters at this, no one would bet
otherwise. There's almost no point in anyone else even
trying.

dialogues.jp: （まあ、１枚くらいはとっておくか……）

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「―――かりほの庵の　苫をあらみ
　わが衣手は　露にぬれつつ」
dialogues.en:
"---Sheltering the harvest-hut Of the autumn rice-field; And
my sleeves are growing wet With the moisture dripping."
dialogues.text:
"---Sheltering the harvest-hut Of the autumn rice-field; And
my sleeves are growing wet With the moisture dripping."

dialogues.jp:
輪のなかに並んだカルタの上を、目にもとまら
ぬ速さで１本の腕が通過する。
dialogues.en:
My eyes departed to the center of the circle we formed, and
I saw a hand passing through the stack of cards.
dialogues.text:
My eyes departed to the center of the circle we formed, and
I saw a hand passing through the stack of cards.

dialogues.en: The owner of that hand was...
dialogues.text: The owner of that hand was...

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「――紅葉ふみわけ　鳴く鹿の
　声きく時ぞ　秋はかなしき」
dialogues.en:
"--Treading through the crimson leaves, The wandering stag
calls. When I hear the lonely cry, Sad--how sad!--the autumn
is."
dialogues.text:
"--Treading through the crimson leaves, The wandering stag
calls. When I hear the lonely cry, Sad--how sad!--the autumn
is."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「こればかりは、朝倉妹にも負けんぞ」
dialogues.en: "I won't lose to you so easily."
dialogues.text: "I won't lose to you so easily."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「―――ふりさけ見れば　春日なる
　三笠の山に　出でし月かも」
dialogues.en:
"--The wide-stretched plain of heaven, Is the moon the same
That rose on Mount Mikasa In the land of Kasuga?"
dialogues.text:
"--The wide-stretched plain of heaven, Is the moon the same
That rose on Mount Mikasa In the land of Kasuga?"

dialogues.jp: カルタを取る音だけが聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: I could hear someone picking up one of the cards.
dialogues.text: I could hear someone picking up one of the cards.

dialogues.jp:
にこやかな笑顔を見せる音夢を見ると、その手
にカルタのカードが握られている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu had a smile on her face, holding one of the playing
cards.
dialogues.text:
Nemu had a smile on her face, holding one of the playing
cards.

dialogues.jp: これが――目にも見えない速さ――。
dialogues.en: That was-- a speed too fast for the human eye--
dialogues.text: That was-- a speed too fast for the human eye--

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「―――春の野に出でて　若菜つむ
　わが衣手に　雪はふりつつ」
dialogues.en:
"--That I walk the fields in spring, Gathering green herbs,
While my garment's hanging sleeves Are speckled with snow."
dialogues.text:
"--That I walk the fields in spring, Gathering green herbs,
While my garment's hanging sleeves Are speckled with snow."

dialogues.jp:
杉並や音夢と、百人一首のカルタでバトルを演
じた。
dialogues.en: I played Hyakunin Isshu with Suginami and Nemu.
dialogues.text: I played Hyakunin Isshu with Suginami and Nemu.
